2608.27394.title: RATIO: A Benchmark for Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations in Scientific Literature
2608.27394.paper_summary: Retrieved scientific literature can serve as inspiration for both human and AI scientists. Inspiration can take different forms: prior work may directly suggest how to address a problem, or surface directions at different levels of abstraction - zooming out to a more general view or zooming in to a concrete realization. We introduce RATIO (Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations), a large-scale benchmark in which relevance is defined by three operations which we name ideation moves: Address retrieves potential approaches for stated problems, Broaden retrieves more general formulations, and Specify retrieves concrete instantiations. RATIO is constructed from millions of full-text scientific papers across CS literature via a general recipe that extends discourse-marker distant supervision - previously used only for classification - to corpus-scale retrieval, combined with extensive LLM and human vetting. Experiments show that operation-specific fine-tuning substantially boosts retrievers but leaves much room for further improvements. RATIO provides a scalable training and evaluation framework for retrieval components that support literature-grounded ideation, opening up new research avenues on scientific inspiration retrieval.
2608.27394.paper_summary_zh: 檢索的科學文獻可以為人類和人工智慧科學家提供靈感。<lb/>靈感可以有不同的形式：先前的工作可能直接建議如何解決一個問題，或者在不同的抽象層次上浮現方向——拉遠到更一般的觀點或拉近到具體的實現。<lb/>我們介紹 RATIO（Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations），這是一個大型基準，其中相關性由三個我們稱之為創意移動的操作來定義：Address 檢索針對陳述問題的潛在方法，Broaden 檢索更一般的表述，而 Specify 檢索具體的實例。<lb/>RATIO 是從數百萬篇計算機科學文獻的全文科學論文中構建而成，通過一個通用的配方，將話語標記的遠程監督（之前僅用於分類）擴展到語料庫規模的檢索，並結合廣泛的 LLM 和人類審核。<lb/>實驗顯示，操作特定的微調顯著提升了檢索器的性能，但仍有很大的改進空間。<lb/>RATIO 提供了一個可擴展的訓練和評估框架，用於支持基於文獻的創意的檢索組件，為科學靈感檢索開辟了新的研究方向。
